title: Lunchline footer
description: A charcoal footer split by a citron hairline: a giant two-line wordmark over the copyright on the left; on the right, a column of section links, a column of legal links, a social icon, and a bottom row with a credit and a back-to-top link. Hovering a link list dims the other links to 32%; the back-to-top arrow lifts 3px; the wordmark fades in as it enters and the top hairline draws itself out.
notes: uses foreground as its background and background as its text, so it inverts with the theme
the wordmark is plain text in the display face
name: lunchline-footer

props.name: brand
